The same continuation recorded a permanent UI-specific interpretation of CODE_HEALTH_RULES.md section 7: for UI screens and visual-alignment work, file/function line-count limits are architectural indicators, not mechanical hard stops, while professional code-quality requirements (cohesion, reuse, no dead duplication, no premature abstraction) remain fully binding. Supabase reads and selected fields, OP display-code formatting, grouping by Pedido, KPI definitions and calculations, search behaviour, tabs and filtering, delivery percentage calculations, pagination at page size 8, table columns and widths, OP type, product type and lifecycle semantics, navigation, controlled deletion through RAVATEX_DELETE.excluirOPComFluxo, the rule that OP creation originates from a Pedido, loading, empty and error behaviour, and responsive scroll ownership are all PRESERVED AND UNCHANGED.
